biomarker: LRRC8A (VRAC influx pump) and SLC31A1 (CTR1) uptake transporter
effect: Reduced cisplatin accumulation inside the cell (Siemer et al. 2021).
Loss of KEAP1 leads to constitutive NRF2 expression supporting tumour cell proliferation (Osman et al. 2023).
Continuous iron expulsion reduces ROS-mediated cell damage; resistance (Yu et al. 2020).
Over-expression expels the drug, causing resistance.
Promotes metastasis through deregulated MMPs (Shaikh et al. 2023).
Glutathione S-transferase upregulation reduces ROS, leading to drug resistance (Ferreira et al. 2023).
ZEB1 is an EMT promoter (Lima De Oliveira et al. 2023).

biomarker: LUM, DCN, IL1A, NRG1, TLE4, AKT2, PKD2, PDGF-C, PDE3B, BACH1
effect: Include PDGF-C (transforming/tumorigenic PDGF ligand), NRG1 (HER ligand; HER2 overexpression renders cisplatin resistance) (Yamano et al. 2010).
Linked to DC-mediated tumour immune response (Qiao et al. 2023).

biomarker: Stemness markers Nanog, Oct4, Bmi1, CD117, CD133, ABCG2
effect: Elevated stemness and tumorigenicity (Tsai et al. 2011).

status: APC and GSK3 downregulated, MMP7 upregulated
effect: Accumulation of cancer stem cells (Milan et al. 2023).
Disrupts IL-17 signalling and cytokine/immune homeostasis in the tumour microenvironment (Qiao et al. 2023).
Activates PI3K/AKT, weakens apoptotic signalling, impairs cisplatin nuclear entry (Hung et al. 2015).
Reduced chromatin acetylation and nuclear translocation of BRCA1 (Almeida et al. 2014).
Regulator of non-canonical WNT pathway that regulates P-gp (Zhang et al. 2024).
Regulator of TGF-beta pathway; increases cancer cell survival (Khattri et al. 2024).
Loss removes protection from ROS (Liu et al. 2022b).
Involved in DNA repair mechanisms (Khera et al. 2023).
ncRNA-related downregulation of FCGBP (Ding et al. 2024).
